title: How a smartphone works
examples: How does the phone know if I am touching the screen?
What part of the phone makes it work?
What is the difference between the chip and the battery?

explain.say: Today we are learning how a smartphone works inside.
The touchscreen lets you interact with the phone display.
The chip is the phone's main brain doing all the thinking.
The battery provides the electrical power to keep everything running.
The radio uses radio waves to connect to networks like Wi-Fi.
Sensors help the phone understand its surroundings around you.

faq.q: How does the phone know where I touched the screen?
faq.a: The touchscreen uses electrical properties to detect where your finger makes contact. It measures changes in electrical fields across its surface. You might also ask: What makes the screen interactive? How does it sense touch? What technology reads my touch?
asks: How does the touchscreen know where you touch?

faq.q: What is the difference between the chip and the battery?
faq.a: The chip is the thinking part that processes information. The battery is the power source that gives electricity to the chip and other parts. You might also ask: Which part does the thinking? Where does the power come from? What is the brain versus the fuel?
asks: What is the difference between the chip and the battery?
Where does the power come from?

faq.q: Do all smartphones use radio waves to connect?
faq.a: Most modern smartphones use radio waves for internet connections like cellular data. They also use Bluetooth for connecting to nearby devices. You might also ask: Is Wi-Fi radio based? What about connecting to headphones? Does it only use one type of wave?
asks: Do all smartphones use radio waves to connect?

faq.q: What do the sensors measure about the world?
faq.a: Sensors measure physical data like movement, light, or distance around you. For example, an accelerometer measures if you are moving or tilting the phone. You might also ask: What is the phone measuring? Can it sense light? What kind of data do they collect?
asks: What do the sensors measure about the world?

faq.q: Does the chip do all the work?
faq.a: No, the chip needs power from the battery to function. The battery provides the energy, and the chip uses that energy to process the signals from the sensors and touchscreen. You might also ask: Can the chip work without power? What needs to happen first? Is power needed for processing?
asks: Does the chip do all the work?
Can the chip work without power?

facts: The chip processes data using electrical signals.
The battery stores chemical energy and converts it to electricity.
Touchscreens work by detecting changes in electrical fields.
Radio waves are used for wireless communication like Wi-Fi.
Sensors measure physical properties like acceleration or light.

quiz.say: If the phone suddenly loses all power, which component stops working immediately?
quiz.why: The battery provides the necessary electrical energy for all other parts to operate.

wrong.0: The radio needs power to send and receive radio waves.
wrong.2: The chip is the brain, but it still needs electricity from the battery to think.
wrong.3: The touchscreen needs power to detect your finger's touch.

quiz.say: When you tilt your phone, which component detects that movement?
quiz.why: Sensors, like the accelerometer, are specifically designed to measure physical changes like movement or tilt.

wrong.1: The chip processes the data, but the sensors are what collect the raw movement information.
wrong.2: The touchscreen only detects contact with your finger, not general movement.
wrong.3: The battery only supplies power; it does not measure movement.

quiz.say: If you want to send a message across town using Wi-Fi, which component handles the transmission?
quiz.why: The radio component uses radio waves to send and receive signals over a distance.

wrong.0: The chip directs the message, but the radio is the part that sends the actual waves.
wrong.1: Sensors measure local things like light or direction, not long-distance signals.
wrong.2: The touchscreen is only for inputting information directly onto the screen.
